_comment: Non-secret config only (golden rule 2). C4 (Knowledge API) holds no tenant data and needs no secret: its whole read grant is one artefact-store prefix (ADR-0007 §1). The non-secret artefact-store root is supplied via the ArtefactStore:Root env var / config key; when unset the host falls back to <BaseDirectory>/artefacts (Program.cs:19). Left unset here deliberately so the null-coalescing fallback applies.
